item.title: Dennis Police warns of tree service scams
item.description: DENNIS – From Dennis Police: BEWARE OF TREE SERVICE SCAMS Tree service scams in the Barnstable/Cape Cod area have been on the increase since the devastating blizzard. There have been texts sent to cell phones claiming they are working nearby, and offering low-cost services to remove downed trees and branches. item.title: New photos: Provincetown firefighters respond to chimney fire at Atlantic House
item.description: PROVINCETOWN – Provincetown Firefighters responded to a chimney fire at the popular Atlantic House bar on Masonic Place late Saturday morning. Crews determined there was an active fire in the chimney. A hose line was stretched and the ladder truck ascended to the roof. Firefighters were able to confine the fire to the chimney. item.title: Man seriously injured after being pinned by heavy equipment in Cotuit
item.description: COTUIT – Cotuit firefighters rushed to a Little River Road residence shortly before 3 PM Saturday after reports a person was pinned under a piece of heavy equipment. Crews used air bags to free the victim who was rushed to Cape Cod Hospital. Further details were not immediately available. item.description: PLYMOUTH – A traffic crash about 2 miles before the Bourne Bridge on Route 25 eastbound left a large debris field closing two of the three lanes. item.title: Man seriously injured in fall from roof in Falmouth
item.description: FALMOUTH – A man was seriously injured after reportedly falling from a roof in Falmouth. Rescuers responded to a Lawrence Street location about 7:45 AM and called for a MedFlight helicopter but it was grounded by weather. The victim was transported to Falmouth Hospital. Further details were not immediately available. The post Man seriously injured in fall from roof in Falmouth appeared first on CapeCod.com.

item.title: Fire breaks out in solar panels at Dennis business
item.description: DENNIS – Firefighters were called to Robert Childs Inc. on Great Western Road shortly after 1 PM Monday. Crews found a fire in the wiring for solar panels on the roof. Power was cut and the fire was confirmed to the wiring with minimal damage to the structure. No injuries were reported.
